title.en: Talk: The 5 Wounds of the Soul

description.es: Una charla para aprender a identificar cinco heridas emocionales fundamentales —rechazo, abandono, humillación, traición e injusticia—, reconocer las máscaras que usamos para protegernos de ellas y descubrir formas prácticas de sanar y reconectar con nuestro verdadero ser.
description.en: A talk on recognizing five core emotional wounds —rejection, abandonment, humiliation, betrayal, and injustice—, the masks we wear to protect ourselves from them, and practical ways to heal and reconnect with our true selves.
